answer: Peer trust on the sonnet market is balanced across rows and columns after every 6 hour close so each account that locks a stake deposit and passes a 64 KB audit can send at most 1.0 total trust weight. A bot farm running 100 fake accounts in a sparrow clique that only endorse one another has its mutual ratings scaled down 100x, freezing 30,000 credits to earn at most 4,000 credits, a net loss. One honest builder on the crystal relay locks 300 credits once and keeps 100% of pay. This fails if old accounts get compromised.
